Read `components.json` for every prop. 5 6 ## Use only these 7 8 - `Money` for every amount: `` shows $24,900. Do not pass your own savings number. 14 - shadcn/ui `Card`, `Badge`, `Button`, `Separator` from `@/components/ui/*` for layout and status. 15 16 ## Never 17 18 1. Type a currency string (`"$24,900"`, `` `$${price}` ``, `

${price}

`) or format currency yourself 19 (`Intl.NumberFormat` or `toLocaleString` with `style: "currency"`). Use `Money`. 20 2. Show a monthly payment ("/mo", "per month") without `PaymentLine`. 21 3. # AGENTS.md: rules for an AI building views with proposal-kit A proposal is something a homeowner signs. Every rule below stops a mistake that looks finished on screen and is wrong on paper. Read `components.json` for every prop. ## Use only these - `Money` for every amount: `` shows $24,900. Pass **whole cents**, never dollars. - `PaymentLine` for every monthly payment: ``. `apr` and `termMonths` are required. The APR and term print on the same line as the payment. - `SavingsEstimate` for every savings figure: ``. It computes the figure, says "Estimated" and prints the assumptions. Do not pass your own savings number. - shadcn/ui `Card`, `Badge`, `Button`, `Separator` from `@/components/ui/*` for layout and status. ## Never 1. Type a currency string (`"$24,900"`, `` `$${price}` ``, `

${price}

`) or format currency yourself (`Intl.NumberFormat` or `toLocaleString` with `style: "currency"`). Use `Money`. 2. Show a monthly payment ("/mo", "per month") without `PaymentLine`. 3. Use a hex, rgb or px value, an inline style size, an arbitrary value like `text-[#0d5c48]`, or a Tailwind palette class like `bg-green-500` (the palette is switched off, so it would render unstyled). Use the token classes: `bg-background`, `bg-card`, `bg-muted`, `text-foreground`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border`, `bg-primary text-primary-foreground`, `bg-success text-success-foreground`, `bg-estimate text-estimate-foreground`. Spacing, type and radius classes (`p-4`, `text-sm`, `rounded-lg`) are tokens too. 4. Show savings without `SavingsEstimate`, drop the word "Estimated", or hide the assumptions. 5. Show a status by color alone. Use `Ready to sign`. Use one `h1`, then `h2` per card. Keep text on token colors; they are all 4.5:1 or better in light and dark. Do not mention tax credits, rebates or incentive amounts. ## Data Keep amounts as whole cents in one data object at the top of the file. Derive totals from it (line items add up to the price; price minus down payment is the amount financed), so every number on the page comes from the same source. ## Check `npm run check` runs TypeScript (required props), ESLint with the `proposal-kit/*` rules, the token check and the tests. A view is done when it passes.

I wrote the summary page to `src/views/GeneratedSummary.tsx`. I couldn't run commands, so I haven't run `npm run check` (TypeScript, lint, token check, tests). The page hasn't been compiled or viewed in a browser yet.

**The page has:**
- **Header:** Maria Okafor's name as the page title, the address, Brightline Home Solar, proposal P-2077 and the November 12, 2026 date. There's a "Ready to sign" badge with a check icon and text, so the status doesn't depend on color alone.
- **Your system:** 7.38 kW, 18 panels at 410 W each, one microinverter per panel, and an estimated 11,900 kWh a year.
